rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Always Remember Me
rows.Origin:
Discovered by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (2007).
Introduced in New Zealand by Matthews Nurseries Ltd. in circa 2007 as 'Hamilton Gardens'.
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2011.
rows.Bloom: Cream and apricot. Flowers soft, peachy apricot. None to mild fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Vigorous.

colour: Cream and apricot. Flowers soft, peachy apricot.
